name: dev-van-life
description: DEV VAN LIFE — your AI agents as dev friends living in a cozy camper van, always driving through a day/night world.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "cd server && npm run dev" "cd web && npm run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd server && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && cd ../web && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
